summary: Tested the 4 NEW capabilities (Approval workflow, Geo-fence check-in, Attendance XLSX export, Share) plus regressions. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases PASSED (see /app/backend/tests/test_fmcg_iter4.py) — every rule from the spec is enforced: salesman-created customers are 'pending', admin-created are 'approved'; salesman can PATCH own pending but is 403'd 'approved and locked' after admin approve; admin PATCH always works; approve endpoint is 403 for salesman; ?approval=pending/approved list filters return the right subsets; salesman scoping intact. Geo-fence: near-territory check-in returns check_in_flagged=false with a numeric check_in_distance_km and no warning; far check-in (Delhi vs Mumbai centroid, radius 10 km) returns flagged=true, distance 1148.12 km and a proper warning string. Salesman POST /api/salesmen with geofence_radius_km=25 persists, is echoed in GET, and PATCH to 7 updates it. Attendance export /api/attendance/export returns HTTP 200, correct XLSX content-type, Content-Disposition attachment filename (attendance_2026-08.xlsx), valid PK zip header, sheets 'Daily' + 'Summary'; ?month=YYYY-MM works; salesman gets 403. Frontend (mobile 390x844): Admin dashboard 'Approvals' tile shows count badge (1 -> 0 after approve), navigation to /approvals lists pending customers with per-row approve buttons (testID approve-{id}); tapping approve removes the row and the dashboard badge updates. Customer list shows 'Pending' chip (testID pending-{id}) on pending customers. AdminAttendance header has attendance-export-btn — pressing it triggers a real XLSX download (Playwright captured attendance_2026-08.xlsx) and the 'Attendance sheet ready' toast appears. AdminAttendance daily row displays a 'km from area' warning badge (testID att-flag-{sid}) for the flagged TEST GeoFlag User: '1148.12 km from area'. SalesmanAttendance for Priya renders without error. **CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG FOUND**: /app/frontend/app/customer/[id].tsx crashes with 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' the moment any customer detail page is opened — `useState(approving)` on line 52 is declared AFTER the conditional early-return on lines 38-46, which violates the React Rules of Hooks. This blocks verification of pending-badge, admin 'Approve this customer' button, edit-button-hidden-for-approved, and both share buttons in the running app (although testIDs and logic are all present in the source). Backend tests confirm the approval + share data pipeline is correct; ONLY the customer detail screen render is broken. Test data cleanup complete (all TEST_* customers deleted).

ui_bugs.issue: Rules-of-Hooks violation: `const [approving, setApproving] = useState(false)` is on line 52, placed AFTER the conditional early-return on lines 38-46 (`if (loading || !c) return <ActivityIndicator/>`). The first render (loading) calls 19 hooks; the second render (data loaded) calls 20, causing a red-screen crash 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' on every customer detail visit. Fix: move the useState(false) call to line 22 (with the other top-level useStates), before the early return.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the customer detail red-screen: hook ordering violation in /app/frontend/app/customer/[id].tsx. React tracks hook calls positionally; when the component first renders with loading=true it early-returns on line 46 having called 19 hooks; when data arrives (loading=false), the component proceeds past line 46 and encounters a 20th hook `useState(approving)` on line 52. React's dev-mode invariant fires 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render' and swaps the tree with a red LogBox. Reproduction: log in as john/priya, tap any customer row -> immediate crash. Mitigation: move the useState declaration to line 22 (with the other useStates) before the early-return branch. No backend impact.
